PASS-1 review (T3 — Integration feasibility overlay): PASS, no findings.

Rationale: the plan integrates no external API/CLI/service/library it has not used before, and every capability it asserts is grounded in existing, already-used repo surfaces:
- Pass-3 replay uses `review_kernel.decide.pass3_decide` / `pass3_over_findings` — internal, existing (`src/rebar/llm/review_kernel/decide.py:631`).
- Pass-2 replay uses the `verify_findings(run_chunk=…)` seam — internal, existing (`src/rebar/llm/review_kernel/verify.py:345`).
- Cost pricing via `genai-prices` — the `genai_prices` module with `calc_price` and `Usage` resolves in the environment and is already consumed by `src/rebar/llm/usage_report.py`.
- Model parity / homogeneous Bedrock chain, `provider_provenance.ran_model`, and prompt-caching (`cache_read_tokens`) all rest on pre-existing, exercised code (`runner.py`, `cache_diagnostics.py`, ADR 0059); the "mixed chain disables caching / roughly doubles cost" rationale is corroborated by the in-repo MEASURED cache_read=0 notes.

Per the overlay's ANTI-FP rule, an internal already-used integration is not-applicable, so no MAJOR asserted-but-unverified-capability finding is warranted.
